name: jk-dashboard-backend
description: JK Dashboard backend — Node.js + Express proxy for the upstream gold_dummy data API.

scripts.deploy: cd .. && git pull origin main && cd backend && (sudo docker ps -q --filter name=jk-dashboard-backend | grep -q . && sudo docker stop jk-dashboard-backend || true) && (sudo docker ps -a -q --filter name=jk-dashboard-backend | grep -q . && sudo docker rm jk-dashboard-backend || true) && (sudo docker images -q jk-dashboard-backend | grep -q . && sudo docker rmi jk-dashboard-backend || true) && sudo docker build -t jk-dashboard-backend . && sudo docker run --restart always -p 8814:8814 --name jk-dashboard-backend -d jk-dashboard-backend
